channel.title: Joel Cook
channel.description: Notes on building applied AI systems that have to work in the real world.

item.title: The Patch That Came Too Late
item.description: How a critical WordPress core vulnerability defaced a college Foundation website—and how I used Codex to contain the attacker, rebuild the site, and verify the recovery.

item.title: The Chatbot That Wasn't Allowed to Guess
item.description: How I built and shipped a public AI agent for a college website — live to ~250,000 visitors a month — by making "don't make things up" a system constraint instead of a prompt.
